title: Vibe coding so many games right now
author: xirrel
selftext: Been building an AI native game engine in rust and luau to make AAA games run in browser. One shotting a game from a single prompt takes roughly 5% of weekly claude max x20 limit which allows us to iterate different ideas really fast. There is still much to do and bugs to fix so it is all about balancing the token budget between making games and improving the engine
